changelog: A partial subtitle extraction is discarded instead of synced (a truncated container exits 0 with part of the track; every extraction is now checked before use); a job that stops making progress is stopped so its run can finish, and no job can be left Running
description: Synchronize subtitles with video audio using ffsubsync
name: SubSync
overview: Adds a Sync Subtitles action to any video, using ffsubsync as backend
